description_en: Updates a China Finance Certification scenario
name: UpdateAntCloudAuthScene

parameters.help_en: This parameter has no effect. You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to deliver authentication files generated during the authentication process to your OSS bucket. Valid values:
Y: enabled.
N (default): disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启投递认证过程产生的认证文件到用户的OSS：
Y：开启
N（默认）：关闭
parameters.name: store_image

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to bind a mini program. Valid values:
Y: enabled.
N (default): disabled.
<notice>If you enable mini program binding, make sure that you specify all parameters related to the mini program binding.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启绑定小程序：
Y：开启
N（默认）：不开启
<notice>如果开启绑定小程序，请确认传递绑定小程序的所有参数。></notice>
parameters.name: bind_mini_program

parameters.help_en: The name of the mini program
parameters.name: mini_program_name

parameters.help_en:
The mini program platform. Valid values:
WECHAT: WeChat
ALIPAY: Alipay
TIKTOK: TikTok
parameters.help_zh:
绑定小程序平台：
WECHAT：微信
ALIPAY：支付宝
TIKTOK：抖音
parameters.name: platform

parameters.help_en: The name of the uploaded verification file
parameters.name: check_file_name

parameters.help_en: The content of the uploaded verification file
parameters.name: check_file_body

parameters.help_en: The number of returned photos (1 to 5). This parameter takes effect after StoreImage is enabled for authentication file retention
parameters.help_zh: 返照数量（1-5），开启storeImage认证文件留存后生效
parameters.name: return_pic_count

parameters.help_en: The duration of the returned video (1 to 2 seconds). This parameter takes effect after StoreImage is enabled
parameters.help_zh: 返视频时长（1-2秒），开启storeImage生效
parameters.name: return_video_length

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable enhanced device risk detection. Valid values:
Y: enabled.
N: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
设备增强检测能力：
Y：开启
N：关闭
parameters.name: device_risk_plus

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable degraded authentication
parameters.name: use_degrade

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable degraded authentication
parameters.name: degrade_type

parameters.help_en: The iOS app scheme for degradation
parameters.name: degrade_app_scheme
